text.description_html:
Fusion PH-S8, Wall Mounted Shaker Toilet Tissue Holder

The Shaker Rose Toilet Paper Holder is a great example of rustic-chic decor. The earthiness of its styling makes it a go-to for many designers to add richness and luxury to a space that can sometimes seem so sterile. It is available in either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-S8 Shaker Towel Bar, Fusion TR-S8 Shaker Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-S8 Shaker Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Sonoma Collection Shaker Trim Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Width: 2-1/2"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
